note: Remarks that exist only in the unmerged candidate PR #47. Kept out of the main findings register.

findings.title: A first-time reader arriving by a link is told about a "saved place" they do not have, and nothing they read is remembered
findings.location: js/sukhmani-reader.js: updateVisitNotice() always names savedPosition, which defaults to the first line when nothing is stored.
findings.evidence: With empty storage, a link to Ashtpadi 17 shows "Visiting a linked passage. Saved place: Ashtpadi 1 · Opening · Ang 262…". Nothing is stored on arrival or after reading on, and the next ordinary opening starts at the beginning with nothing offered. reviews/claude-independent/retests/RT-003/evidence/r2x04_linked_visit.json (part J).
findings.why_it_matters: Someone who first meets the app through a shared link reads a whole Ashtpadi and the app remembers none of it, while telling them about a place they never set.
findings.proposed_correction: When nothing is stored: "You have no saved place yet. Reading here will not be saved unless you choose to use it as your reading place."
findings.acceptance_test: With empty storage the visit notice does not name a saved place, and says plainly that reading here is not being saved.

findings.title: On a small phone the visit notice takes just over a third of the screen
findings.location: css/sukhmani.css: .sk-link-visit and .sk-visit-actions (buttons at flex 1 1 140px wrap onto separate rows below 360 pixels).
findings.evidence: Notice height 201 px of a 568 px screen (35 per cent) at 320 wide; 162 of 667 (24 per cent) at 375; 162 of 844 (19 per cent) at 390. Everything stays reachable and the linked line is clear of it. reviews/claude-independent/retests/RT-003/evidence/r2x04_linked_visit.json (part K).
findings.why_it_matters: On the smallest phones a third of the reading area is given to the notice for as long as the visit lasts.
findings.proposed_correction: Keep the two buttons side by side at narrow widths, or shorten the sentence once the reader has scrolled past the linked line.
findings.acceptance_test: The notice takes no more than about a fifth of the screen height at 320 pixels wide, with both buttons still at least 44 pixels.
